notes.title: Short Digital Manga Release Now!
notes.content:
Manga "Welcome to the Karoshi Club" Release!
Hooray! The manga "Welcome to the Karoshi Club" is now available for free download!

The manga author is Valerie Yogay, an old-school mangaka.
This style is something you are going to absolutely love!
We want to thank everyone who contributed to its development!

We are excited to share some inside information about Kenji Haishima, the Keneō Industry, and the afterlife world of Yomi.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788712/abc38d3c282e2874ecc9d065f5ba60e99182cc11.png

How to read and access manga?

1. Add the DLC to your library and download the minor update.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2722510/Welcome_to_the_Karoshi_Club_Manga/

2. Right-click on the game Welcome to the Karoshi Club in your library and click "Properties":

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788712/2dc001920f3f6f1ae1718c21e1d022a9eae5bc24.png

3. In the next window, select "Installed Files" and next to the section "Size of Installation," click on the "Browse" button.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788712/da25b83ebe14edfc732067c04c89348da443fac6.png

4. Click on the KaroshiManga folder, and the PDF manga file will be there!

(The manga is implemented through the functionality of additional files for the game, for example, as an game art book)

When can we expect translations in other languages?

The manga is only available in English, but we plan to add Russian and Japanese translations as additional PDF files this month.



We hope you enjoy this brief explanation of Yomi's afterlife features.
Looking forward to seeing you for the Karoshi Club announcement!

Yours, Kamishibai Teams.

notes.title: Welcome to the Update 1.2
notes.content:
Welcome to the Update 1.2

We are delighted to announce that update 1.2, which includes several new wishes mentioned in community game reviews, is launching today.

We appreciate all the feedback we received from you and are grateful for your valuable comments and suggestions. Your continuous support and feedback have helped us improve our project, and we would like to express our gratitude for your contribution.

Thank you for being with us on this journey to improve our free prologue Welcome to the Karoshi Club.

New Features:

 Add Volume Settings in the Main menu:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788712/d4420d3911a807d11ac3f7b43b34bcc887cf70bd.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788712/c974b90a9b480d68453446fd90e17879ac38949c.png
Sound settings are saved when switching scenes, and volume adjustments can be made in the main menu.


 Rewind Functional:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788712/d73a44b19c39076d20990406dfadfe7840da1623.png
After completing the game for the first time, when you start playing it again, and a new act is announced, you will notice a rewind button on the upper right corner of the screen. This button will take you directly to the question in the act, making playtime in the game easier.


 Add Italian Language Support (Many thanks to Francesco Papeo):

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788712/897e3d8192b992f8a98016f5286e130e33918572.png
We are thrilled when people offer to help translate our game into other languages. It warms our hearts, and we are highly grateful for their support. We are excited to announce that we now have Italian language support in the game thanks to the talented specialist from Italy, Francesco Papeo! The entire team is grateful for your contribution and would like to express our gratitude.

Karoshi Japanese LQA Help
We have received comments that the Japanese translation of our project, Welcome to the Karoshi Club, may contain some errors in understanding. If someone in our community is a specialist in Japanese and can help us with Language Quality Assurance (LQA), we kindly request you to respond on our Discord channel. 

In return for your assistance, we would be delighted to include your name in the credits for Welcome to the Karoshi Club.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788712/2bb28050fa743c9bc48bcab25473b52ff876b68e.png

Manga "Welcome to the Karoshi Club" release window
We apologize for the delay in releasing the promised manga and Update 1.2. We have decided to make some necessary improvements before its release.

We are working on a short manga that will connect the story of Welcome to the Karoshi Club with the Karoshi Club. We anticipate that it will be released in late May or early June. We are trying to complete it by then, and we hope you will enjoy getting to know Kumi Yamane.

Make sure to add the manga to your wishlist for release updates.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2722510/Welcome_to_the_Karoshi_Club_Manga/

Karoshi Community Spotlight - April
If you're interested in showcasing your creativity in the Karoshi Club universe, we'd love to feature you in our future Community Spotlights, particularly for the Letsplay game and fan art! Please use our Community Hub in Steam.

/ᐠ - ⩊ -マ₊˚⊹♡₊ ⊹


ONE HECK OF A JOB INTERVIEW!!! | Welcome to Karoshi Club by Game Zane

Let's say goodbye for now and greet each other again in the future

Well, we can finally close the chapter on Welcome to the Karoshi Club and fully immerse ourselves in our new projects, Karoshi Club and Project: Celestine. 

This will be the last major update for our free prologue, and we will only have small updates from now on. We want to express our gratitude for your support and feedback.

Thank you to all those who have been with us from the beginning until now. You guys are the best!

We will announce Karoshi Club by releasing the manga Welcome to the Karoshi Club.

We are preparing something unfamiliar and unusual, so stay tuned!

Yours, Kamishibai team.

notes.title: Happy Karoshi Day [04.04]
notes.content:
Karoshi Day
Happy Karoshi Day to all Karoshi Club members!

Today marks the official start of the development of Karoshi Club's main product.

We want to take this opportunity to pay tribute to all those who have suffered from toxic company cultures.
Please do not tolerate toxic behavior, manipulation, or mistreatment from coworkers.
We are confident you will always find a new workplace with supportive and respectful individuals.

The main project of the Karoshi Club will focus on these themes.

The End of Karoshi Club Community Challenges
We are incredibly grateful to everyone who participated in our Community Challenges. Although we could not achieve our goals, we appreciate all your effort and support. 

If you are concerned about the main game's development, please rest assured that we are committed to bringing it to fruition. Your feedback and reviews have shown us a demand for this project, and we are excited to continue its development for you.

We are staying at Discord Community Challenges until August 8th, 2024.

During this time, we have made some progress in our game.
The number of games added to the Steam library was 27190.
We had 1532 players total.
And our Discord community currently has 58 members.

We consider these numbers a triumph! Thank you so much for your support!

Main Karoshi Club - Future
Our team A is currently dedicated to creating a demo of all the mechanics in Karoshi Club.
Once the demo is completed, we will start collaborating with publishers to seek financing and promotion for the game.
We will keep you updated on our progress throughout this journey.

Please note that although the Community Challenges bonuses have expired, we greatly appreciate your support and will explore alternative methods to achieve these bonuses in the future.

Project: Celestine
Fantastic news from team B is working on a new project in the Souls Like genre, and we hope to announce it soon.
However, developing this project will require significant time and effort.
We want to keep you informed of our progress and share the initial developments of this project with you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788712/643b5832fb867de448803c0563744b007bc7ba80.png
You can learn more about Project: Celestine by joining our Discord!

Get ready for a new Karoshi Club update!

Release Notes Update 1.1:

 Text: Some English phrases have been simplified, but the text editors have not yet completed the editing process. The final edits will be included in the next update
 Gameplay: New images have been added to the neutral and bad endings
 Settings: Added music volume slider

Localization Pack #1
We are happy to announce the release of the first localization pack—many thanks to everyone who assisted us in implementing it, including translators and LQA experts.


Add Support Japanese Language Pack
Add Support Russian Language Pack


If you notice any issues with the localization, please don't hesitate to report it to us on our Discord server. We have created a separate topic and questionnaire specifically for this purpose. We would appreciate it if you could take the time to help us improve the localization. Thank you!

Future Plans
Update 1.2 plans:

 Text: The English text has been updated based on the edits made by the editors
 Gameplay: Rewind functional. We postponed this feature to the next update after failing to resolve this functionality bug quickly
 Localization: Add new language packs created by volunteer translators


Team Feedback
We are delighted that you have provided us with feedback and have been supporting us in general! We want to extend our special thanks to you for promoting Welcome to the Karoshi Club.

It inspires us and makes us even stronger.

We hope you enjoy the new updates for "Welcome to Club Karoshi". We'll see you in the new Community Info update with the manga release, "Welcome to the Karoshi Club," and future Version 1.2.

Your, Kamishibai Cat

notes.title: Happy New Year Karoshi Members!
notes.content:
Thanks from the developers

We want to extend our most profound appreciation to all those who have written reviews and helped Welcome to the Karoshi Club gain more popularity on Steam. Your support motivates us to enhance the main Karoshi Club experience.

Also, thank you to everyone who supports us on the X social network.

We would also like to thank everyone who took the time to fill out our feedback form. Your feedback has provided valuable insights on improving Welcome to the Karoshi Club - Update 1.1.

Future Update 1.1 - Q1, 2024

Game Text
We are worried that the language used in the text may be too complex and literary for most readers.
As a result, we have paused the localization process and decided to hire text proofreading professionals. Their job is to identify the parts of the text that are difficult to comprehend. Although this may cause a slight delay in the localization process, we hope this step will help make the text in Welcome to the Karoshi Club more accessible and easier to read.

Important Notice: We regret to inform you that we are running a little behind schedule with the release of the separate PDF manga, which has been mentioned in the game description. However, we are working diligently to finalize the editing and make necessary image corrections. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and kindly request you visit us again soon. Once completed, you can activate the Manga as a separate free DLC for Welcome to the Karoshi Club. Thank you for your patience and understanding.

Please don't forget to take advantage of the first free bonus, the game soundtrack.

Your Feedback
You will find an icon shaped like a heart within the main menu. Click on this icon if you would like to share your thoughts and feedback on Welcome to the Karoshi Club, the visual novel. We highly value your opinions and feelings. Please take a moment to fill out the questionnaire and let us know what we can improve upon and what we did well. We appreciate your feedback! <3

notes.title: Welcome to our weird and wonderful "Karoshi Club"
notes.content:
First News
We are excited to inform you that "Welcome to the Karoshi Club" is ready for release, and we can't wait for you to play it on your computers. 

Also, we are happy to report that the game runs smoothly on SteamDeck.
Since the game is black and white art style, be careful with the OLED version of SteamDeck and do not play for a very-very long time so that you are OK with your screen pixels.

However, we have temporarily disabled the text logging and rewind functionality due to a bug. We are actively fixing it and hope to release a small update soon to enable this functionality again.

Release Reminder
Remember that the free visual novel will be available on December 27th!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788712/c2dda0ff22935dfebb626555ac32bf9d249f06dd.png

Localization Planning

Players from the following regions have shown the highest interest in Welcome to the Karoshi Club:
1st place - USA Region
2nd place - CIS Region
3rd place - Japan

We will introduce Japanese and Russian language support during the early in the first quarter of 2024.

We have received some feedback from volunteers who enjoyed playing Welcome to the Karoshi Club and suggested that we translate the game into simplified Chinese. We are currently working on this translation. We will provide additional information at a later time.

If you are interested in helping us with localization into other languages, please join our Discord server. We would be happy to add you to the game credits and potentially work with you on a paid basis for our main project - "Karoshi Club".

Early Concepts

Today, we have some early concept art of a recruiter named Hitomi Takemitsu from Keneō Industry. The name is a tribute to Hitomi Shimizu and Toru Takemitsu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788712/ab013acb6afddf78a6f38e2add38c36cba4c4b9d.png

If you're feeling scared, our job is on the right path /ᐠﹷ ‸ ﹷ ᐟ\ﾉ

We are excited for you to join our upcoming horror business punk world and become a member of the Karoshi Club.

We can't wait to see you at the release!

Your, Kamishibai Cat /ᐠ｡‸｡ᐟ\
